_comment: Model B in EMA form (2026-10-15): W <- (1 - eta) W + eta Im S with eta = 0.125 (8-block window), read Hebb + alpha W. Fixed point W = Im S, so alpha_init 1 as in A. Torch path (~105 ms/step on RTX 4090). Motivation: on B 40k (leaky, rho 0.5) the scale-preserving EMA at inference raised late solves 15 -> 33 with no solved puzzle lost; window 8 was the best of 2/4/8/16.
